about: The evidence rules and coverage by clause kind on one table of cases. The NEEDs are the agreed NEEDs of the r1 gas-station project GASV6A3 at snapshot 344. refusedBy: the number of the first rule that refuses, null when every rule holds.

needs.statement: The pricing team needs the central service to publish gas price updates to gas stations.
The pricing team needs to account for new desired prices arriving while earlier sends are still in flight.
The pricing team needs only eventual correctness to matter.
The pricing team needs each station to settle on the latest price.
The pricing team needs to account for sends possibly arriving at the station out of order.
The pricing team needs all acknowledgements to come back in order.
The pricing team needs to account for stations being dumb, with versioning or deduplication impossible to add on their side.
The pricing team wants the cost of sending kept low and does not want to spam stations.
The pricing team wants unnecessary updates avoided.
The pricing team wants the cost of not sending kept low as well.
The pricing team needs to account for stations acting on stale prices.
